Treatment Summary
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot, reporting neck pain and stiffness consistent with
a whiplash mechanism. The reported injury is in keeping with the kind and force of the impact. No prior injury to the
cervical region is known to this provider. Over the course of 24 visits, care included manual therapy, range-of-motion
exercises, and a home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as
symptoms improved and function returned. Nearly all of the documented symptoms rest on the patient's own
descriptions of pain, as cervical imaging and standard clinical examination maneuvers were within normal limits.
Billed services reflect the planned course of care, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Discharge plan
includes continued self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.
